description: Mark one step pass, fail or na, with who did it and when. na means the step did not apply; it counts as answered and never as passed. A step can be answered again while the run is open, and the last answer stands.

at.description: The day it was answered, YYYY-MM-DD. Default the run's own date

by.description: Who answered it. Printed against the step on the report

item.description: The step id, e.g. I03, as shown by run_show

note.description: What was found. Say why on a fail: the report prints this under the step

run.description: The run id, e.g. RUN-2026-0001, or its title when only one carries it

state.description: pass, fail, na for did not apply, or pending to put the step back to unanswered

name: run_check
title: Answer a step in a run
